_meta.notes: Two booted CPUs and no pinned tagname, which is the state the CPU picker exists for: with one CPU the widget targets it silently and the picker is not drawn at all. Then the link drops: the transport disconnects after the scene is staged, so every reading this widget draws is held rather than current.

_scene.caption: Two CPUs in range and none pinned, so the widget asks which one to run on rather than guessing
